svg.title: Emergency dispatcher — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as emergency dispatcher, wearing a work uniform and a communications headset. Visible work cue: A sloped dispatch radio console has an upright antenna, display and two separated controls. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a communications headset.
